021import org.bukkit.plugin.Plugin;
022import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
023import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
024
025import java.util.List;
026import java.util.Map;
027import java.util.UUID;
028
029/**
030 * ShopPermission
031 *
032 * @author creatorfromhell
033 * @since 6.3.0.0
034 */
035public interface ShopPermission {
036
037  /**
038   * Gets all player and their group on this shop
039   *
040   * @return Map of UUID and group
041   */
042  @NotNull
043  Map<UUID, String> getPermissionAudiences();
044
045  /**
046   * Gets specific player group on specific shop
047   *
048   * @param player player
049   *
050   * @return namespaced group
051   */
052  @NotNull
053  String getPlayerGroup(@NotNull UUID player);
054
055  /**
056   * Check if player have authorized for specific permission on specific shop
057   *
058   * @param player     player
059   * @param namespace  permission namespace
060   * @param permission permission
061   *
062   * @return true if player have authorized
063   */
064  boolean playerAuthorize(@NotNull UUID player, @NotNull Plugin namespace, @NotNull String permission);
065
066  /**
067   * Check if player have authorized for specific permission on specific shop
068   *
069   * @param player     player
070   * @param permission namespaced permission
071   *
072   * @return true if player have authorized
073   */
074  boolean playerAuthorize(@NotNull UUID player, @NotNull BuiltInShopPermission permission);
075
076  /**
077   * Gets the player list of who can authorize specific permission on this shop
078   *
079   * @param permission permission
080   *
081   * @return Collection of UUID
082   */
083  List<UUID> playersCanAuthorize(@NotNull BuiltInShopPermission permission);
084
085  /**
086   * Gets the player list of who can authorize specific group on this shop
087   *
088   * @param permissionGroup group
089   *
090   * @return Collection of UUID
091   */
092  List<UUID> playersCanAuthorize(@NotNull BuiltInShopPermissionGroup permissionGroup);
093
094  /**
095   * Gets the player list of who can authorize specific permission on this shop
096   *
097   * @param permission raw permission
098   * @param plugin     namespace of permission
099   *
100   * @return Collection of UUID
101   */
102  List<UUID> playersCanAuthorize(@NotNull Plugin plugin, @NotNull String permission);
103
104  /**
105   * Sets specific player permission on specfic shop
106   *
107   * @param player player
108   * @param group  namespaced group name
109   */
110  void setPlayerGroup(@NotNull UUID player, @Nullable String group);
111
112  /**
113   * Sets specific player permission on specfic shop
114   *
115   * @param player player
116   * @param group  group
117   */
118  void setPlayerGroup(@NotNull UUID player, @Nullable BuiltInShopPermissionGroup group);
119}
